import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

# Load data
with open('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/8gen_per_gen_spearman.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

features = ['entropy_mean', 'entropy_std', 'entropy_max', 'entropy_min', 'ttr', 'hapax_ratio', 'tail_decay']
feature_labels = ['Entropy\nmean', 'Entropy\nstd', 'Entropy\nmax', 'Entropy\nmin', 'TTR', 'Hapax\nratio', 'Tail\ndecay']

generators = data['_generators']
medians = data['_median']

# Color mapping by family
family_colors = {
    'pythia-1b': '#2171b5',
    'pythia-2.8b': '#2171b5',
    'olmo-2-1b': '#238b45',
    'qwen3-0.6b': '#d95f02',
    'qwen3-1.7b': '#d95f02',
    'qwen3-8b': '#d95f02',
    'llama-3.2-3b': '#cb181d',
    'mistral-7b-v0.3': '#6a3d9a',
}

# Figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))

# y=0 reference line
ax.axhline(0, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, zorder=1)

# Strip plot
np.random.seed(42)
for i, feat in enumerate(features):
    # Per-generator dots with jitter
    for gen in generators:
        val = data[gen][feat]
        jitter = np.random.uniform(-0.15, 0.15)
        ax.scatter(i + jitter, val, color=family_colors[gen], s=45, zorder=3,
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.4, alpha=0.85)
    # Pooled median line
    med_val = medians[feat]
    ax.plot([i - 0.25, i + 0.25], [med_val, med_val], color='#333333', linewidth=1.8, zorder=4)

ax.set_xticks(range(len(features)))
ax.set_xticklabels(feature_labels, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('Spearman ρ with depth', fontsize=10.5)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(features) - 0.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Legend by family
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#2171b5', markersize=7, label='Pythia'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#238b45', markersize=7, label='OLMo'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#d95f02', markersize=7, label='Qwen'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#cb181d', markersize=7, label='Llama'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#6a3d9a', markersize=7, label='Mistral'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color='#333333', linewidth=1.8, label='Pooled median'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower left', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.9,
          ncol=3, columnspacing=1.0, handletextpad=0.4)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/fig1_differential_response.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/fig1_differential_response.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
print("Done")
PYEOF
